parameters.name: AddList
parameters.description: The protected objects to add to the protected object group. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,). If this parameter is empty, no protected objects are added to the protected object group.

parameters.name: DeleteList
parameters.description: The protected objects to remove from the protected object group. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,). If this parameter is empty, no protected objects are removed from the protected object group.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the protected object group. The description can be up to 512 characters long.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the protected object group to modify.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is located. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
